title: Path program phase transfer
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, $B$ a natural number, $P$ a proposition, and $\sigma$ a program register state whose nine register values are all at most $B$. Suppose $2|x|+2\le B$, the source $s$ and guessed next vertex $nx$ satisfy $s<n$ and $nx<n$, and $2n+2+2n^2\le |x|$, where $n$ is the vertex-count register. If the path program, started at the label $wrd$ with input pointer $2n+2+2(sn+nx)$, row register $s$, and column register $nx$, has the termination, register-bound, and acceptance properties expressed by $PS$ with conclusion $P$, then the same properties hold when it is started at label $wcp$ with register state $\sigma$ and conclusion $P$.
hypotheses_covered: all nine register values of $\sigma$ are at most $B$
the specified $wrd$-stage configuration satisfies $PS$ with proposition $P$
